_doc: T-1268. A `prdt track land` whose diff touches any path in a package's `scans` ALWAYS runs that package's `tests` (tests that read a SOURCE directory by listing it — a change there is reached by no import and no name), and a diff touching the package itself ALSO runs the package's own extra test steps (core: schema-v-guard.mjs). `exempt` = reviewed test files that list a sandbox they built, not repo source. test/scripts/directory-scanner-list.test.ts keeps this honest: it fails when a test file reads a source dir and is in neither list.

exempt.electron/ipc/onboarding.downgrade.test.t: lists the .claude/agents of a sandbox home it built, not a repo directory
exempt.electron/prdt-bootstrap.test.ts: lists the .prdt and .claude/agents trees of two sandbox homes it bootstrapped, not a repo directory
